annotations.text:
Health OS — web app wireframe (low-fi)
Flow: Log in → Dashboard (upload records) → Chat. Grey bars are placeholder text; one accent marks primary/interactive elements.
Records upload here (drag-drop or browse; images + PDF) and feed context into the AI chat — e.g. it can cite Blood_test.pdf.

Accessibility for linguistic barriers:
• Mic = speech → text (STT) for voice input
• Listen = text → speech (TTS) reads replies aloud
• Language pill switches both
• "Connect with a practitioner" escalates to a human.
